<function name="GetHitBoxCount" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Gets how many hit boxes are in a given hit box set.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="set" type="number">The number of the hit box set.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The number of hit boxes.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Will print out how many hit boxes the client has in each of their hit box sets.</description>
	<code>
local numHitSetGroups = LocalPlayer():GetHitboxSetCount()

for i = 0, numHitSetGroups - 1 do
	local numHitBoxes = LocalPlayer():GetHitBoxCount( i )
	print( "Hit box set " .. i .. " has " .. numHitBoxes .. " hit boxes!" )
end
	</code>
	<output>Hit box set 0 has 17 hit boxes!</output>
</example>
